title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 测量、权利、准入与监控：从空气传感器到公共技术合同
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：measurement, rights, access, and surveillance（测量、权利、准入与监控）。空气质量需要被测量，身体安全需要法律承认，阅读机会取决于价格与传播，而监控技术的扩张则要求公共机构说明谁在收集数据、为了什么目的。

items.title: 洛杉矶社区用传感器绘制街区空气污染
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，洛杉矶 Pacoima 社区正在建立超本地空气质量监测网络，传感器被安装在住宅、办公室，甚至居民随身携带的包上。当地长期承受高速公路、机场和工业设施叠加的污染。项目希望把居民的日常感受转化为可用于健康研究和政策倡议的数据，也提醒我们：看不见的环境风险，往往首先需要被社区自己测量。
items.correspondingEnglish: Residents in Pacoima, one of Los Angeles's most polluted neighborhoods, are building a hyperlocal air-quality network. Sensors placed on homes, offices and even bags can reveal how pollution changes from one street to another. The project turns lived experience into evidence and gives the community stronger tools for demanding healthier infrastructure.

englishExpressions.example: An air-quality sensor can reveal pollution at street level.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 超本地数据；精确到小范围社区的数据
englishExpressions.example: Hyperlocal data can show differences between nearby streets.
Some communities carry a heavier environmental burden than others.

items.title: 美国联邦法官阻止阿拉巴马州使用氮气执行死刑
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，一名美国联邦法官阻止阿拉巴马州以氮气缺氧方式处决 Jeffery Lee，认定该州提出的执行方案违反美国宪法对残酷和非常刑罚的禁止。案件把死刑争议带回一个具体问题：当国家掌握剥夺生命的权力时，司法审查如何评估痛苦、证据与人的尊严。
items.correspondingEnglish: A U.S. federal judge blocked Alabama from executing Jeffery Lee by nitrogen gas. The judge found that the proposed method violated the constitutional ban on cruel and unusual punishment. The ruling shows how judicial review can place limits on state power when bodily suffering and human dignity are at stake.

englishExpressions.example: Judicial review can limit the exercise of state power.
The Constitution prohibits cruel and unusual punishment.
Courts examine how state power affects individual rights.

items.title: 英国平等法保护引发关于“常识”与权利的争论
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，英国保守党领袖 Kemi Badenoch 就《平等法》的保护范围发表讲话，将部分改革主张描述为恢复“常识”。争议显示，“常识”并不是中性的语言：它可能简化复杂的法律保护，也可能决定哪些群体的经验被视为合理。讨论平等法时，需要区分政治口号、现行法律与实际生活中的歧视风险。
items.correspondingEnglish: A debate over Britain's Equality Act has focused on claims about restoring 'common sense' to legal protections. Yet common sense is not a neutral standard: it can hide disagreements about whose experiences count and which risks deserve recognition. Clear discussion requires separating political language from existing law and its effects on everyday life.

englishExpressions.example: Legal protection should be clear and enforceable.
A common-sense claim may conceal a political choice.
The law covers several protected characteristics.

items.title: 英国男子因新法下的列车性骚扰罪首次被判刑
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，一名男子因在伦敦列车上骚扰乘客而被判刑，成为英国相关新法律实施后的首宗判刑案例。案件说明，公共交通中的性骚扰不再只被当作令人不适的个人遭遇，而开始被法律明确命名和追责。规则能否真正改变日常安全，还取决于举报机制、执法培训和公众对边界的共同理解。
items.correspondingEnglish: A man has received the first sentence under a new law covering sexual harassment on public transport in Britain. The case gives a legal name to behavior that was often dismissed as merely uncomfortable. Lasting change, however, also depends on reporting systems, trained staff and a shared understanding of personal boundaries.

englishExpressions.example: Sexual harassment can make public transport feel unsafe.
Everyone should be able to use public transport safely.
The first sentence may set a legal precedent.

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: 大都会博物馆“Musical Bodies”：乐器也是身体关系的历史
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 介绍纽约大都会艺术博物馆展览 Musical Bodies。展览跨越约四千年的音乐史，观察身体如何演奏、触碰和赋予乐器意义。它没有把乐器只当作玻璃柜中的物件，而是讨论呼吸、动作、仪式与身份如何共同制造声音。博物馆在这里成为理解身体与技术关系的场所。
items.correspondingEnglish: The Metropolitan Museum of Art's exhibition Musical Bodies explores about 4,000 years of relationships between people and instruments. Rather than treating instruments as silent objects, it considers breath, touch, movement, ritual and identity. The exhibition presents music as something created through the meeting of bodies, materials and social life.

englishExpressions.example: A musical instrument becomes meaningful through performance.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 具身经验；通过身体获得的经验
englishExpressions.example: Music is an embodied experience shaped by breath and movement.
Museums use material culture to tell social histories.

items.title: Booker Prize 推出一英镑短篇读物，回应成人阅读率下降
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，Booker Prize 推出售价一英镑的 Quick Read 短篇小说集，希望让更多成年人接触高质量文学。这个项目回应英国成人阅读率下降，也把文化准入落到价格、篇幅和分发渠道上。阅读推广不只是告诉人们“应该读书”，还要降低时间、金钱和信心上的门槛。
items.correspondingEnglish: The Booker Prize has launched a one-pound Quick Read collection to widen access to high-quality fiction. The project responds to falling adult reading rates by addressing practical barriers such as price, length and confidence. Encouraging reading requires more than praise for books; it also requires formats that fit people's lives.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 扩大准入；让更多人能够获得
englishExpressions.example: Low-cost editions can widen access to literature.
The project responds to a decline in the adult reading rate.
Price can be a practical barrier to cultural participation.

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: 五大湖拟部署军用监控无人机，引发公共边界担忧
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，美国有关机构计划在五大湖地区使用军用级监控无人机。支持者强调边境与水域监测能力，批评者则担心设备收集的数据、飞行范围和使用目的缺少足够透明度。当高性能监控工具进入民用空间，问题不只是它能看多远，也是谁授权、谁保存信息，以及公众如何提出异议。
items.correspondingEnglish: Plans to use military-grade surveillance drones over the Great Lakes have raised questions about privacy and public accountability. Supporters point to stronger monitoring of borders and waterways, while critics want clearer limits on flight areas, data collection and information storage. A powerful sensor needs rules that are as visible as its capabilities.

englishExpressions.example: A surveillance drone can observe a wide area from the air.
Public agencies should explain the purpose of data collection.
Military technology requires clear limits in civilian space.

items.title: Palantir 就伦敦警察技术合同受阻起诉市长
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，数据技术公司 Palantir 因伦敦市长 Sadiq Khan 阻止其获得大都会警察厅合同而提起诉讼。争议把公共采购、企业声誉、数据治理和民主授权放到同一张桌上。警方是否采用某项技术，不能只看效率与价格，也需要审视供应商、数据用途、监督机制和公众信任。
items.correspondingEnglish: Palantir has sued London mayor Sadiq Khan after he blocked the company from receiving a Metropolitan police contract. The dispute connects public procurement with data governance, corporate reputation and democratic authority. Choosing police technology involves more than cost and efficiency; it also requires scrutiny of vendors, data use and public trust.

englishExpressions.example: Public procurement should be transparent and accountable.
The company challenged the decision over a police contract.
Sensitive technology requires careful vendor scrutiny.

englishParagraph.english: Today's stories show that visibility is never only about seeing. Sensors can make pollution measurable, while law can make harassment and bodily suffering recognizable. Affordable books can open cultural doors, but surveillance systems can also extend the power to watch. The central question is therefore not whether information exists, but who gathers it, who can use it and which rights limit that power.
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻显示，可见性从来不只是“看见”。传感器让污染变得可测量，法律让骚扰与身体痛苦得到承认；低价图书可以打开文化之门，监控系统却也可能扩张观看他人的权力。因此，核心问题不只是信息是否存在，而是谁收集信息、谁能够使用，以及哪些权利可以限制这种权力。

keywords.meaning: 测量；把现象转化为可比较的数据
keywords.example: Environmental measurement can support community action.

keywords.meaning: 司法审查；法院审查公权力是否合法
keywords.example: Judicial review protects rights by examining state decisions.
Legal protection matters only when people can use it.

keywords.meaning: 文化准入；接触和参与文化的机会
监控；持续观察和收集信息
keywords.example: Surveillance requires strict limits and public oversight.

keywords.meaning: 公共采购；政府或公共机构购买商品与服务
keywords.example: Public procurement decisions should earn public trust.

sentenceLab.sentence: The central question is not whether information exists, but who gathers it, who can use it and which rights limit that power.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: 句子用 not ... but ... 把焦点从“信息是否存在”转向权力关系。whether、who 和 which 引导三个名词性从句；后半句的并列结构依次追问收集者、使用者与权力边界。

reflection.english: Making something visible can protect people, but the power to see must itself remain visible.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：让问题变得可见可以保护人，但观看他人的权力本身也必须保持可见。

推送日期｜2026年6月9日

今天的小报关键词是：measurement, rights, access, and surveillance（测量、权利、准入与监控）。

认真读新闻，也是在追问：谁有权测量、命名、观看和决定。
